title: Sequential Decision Making
standfirst: Bandits, MDPs and the theory behind decisions taken one after another under uncertainty.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces the core concepts and algorithms for sequential decision-making, covering three learning paradigms based on feedback: online learning (full information), multi-armed bandits (partial information), and reinforcement learning (partial information with state changes). It also explores key algorithms and applications for each paradigm.
